227: One is permitted to send his friend game, an animal or a chicken, even living ones, or wines, oils, flours, and legumes, but not produce because that needs to be ground, which is a forbidden labor on a holiday.

When it is permitted to send something on a holiday, one should not send it in a line, meaning three or more men in a line carrying one type of thing. If each one carries something different, it is permitted.

We send clothes, even if not stitched up, because they can be leaned on, even if they are made of a forbidden mixture, as long as they are tough. We send tefillin because it can be worn on a weekday. Rem"a: And anything similar can be sent, even through the public domain (Beit Yosef).
